notes:
Summary: Mid-market product infra team evaluating Redwood for customer-facing chat and internal search. Primary goal: replace a costly multi-cloud LLM API layer and reduce per-token spend while preserving latency <= 200ms tail for chat 95th percentile. Started with Hosted API evaluation, now moving to Dedicated sizing POC and cost workshop.

Decision drivers:
- Cost predictability (want monthly commit with burstable capacity).
- Latency SLOs: 95th <= 200ms for short chat (context ~512 tokens), batchable embeddings pipeline for nightly indexing.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, enterprise KMS, audit logs; data residency not strict but prefer NA region.
- Model preference: open model family (Llama2/3-style variants) and Redwood-verified quantized variants; willing to consider Redwood model recommendations.

POC scope agreed: 2-week Dedicated pilot (8 GPUs) + cost optimization workshop to validate batching/cache/quantization gains. Engineering asked for:
- baseline hosted API telemetry (latency, token counts) from prod sampling
- simulated batching scenarios for chat (single-shot vs. micro-batching)
- KV/prefix caching demo for common prompts to reduce prompt tokens
- quantized model profiles (int8/4-bit) with perf/cost tradeoffs

Quotes/feedback:
- "If we can get 30-50% token spend reduction without hurting 95th latency we're in" - Senior PM (call 2026-03-02).
- "Need a clear unit-econ spreadsheet we can drop into finance review" - Head of Engineering.

Artifacts: pricing deck and security Qs shared (drive:/decks/novastream-redwood-pricing-v2.pdf, drive:/security/novastream-security-questions.md). Gmail thread for commercial terms: thread:6789012345.
